recaps.title: Hornets Open Season With Back-to-Back Wins
recaps.varsityHeadline: Varsity: 1st of 16 at East Ridge — Welcome to the Season
recaps.varsityBody:
If you showed up to StoneRidge Golf Club last Tuesday representing one of the other 15 programs in the East Ridge Invitational field, we'd like to offer our condolences. Edina Boys Golf was not in a sympathetic mood.

The Hornets carded a 293 (+5) to take first place outright — a result that probably had a few coaches in the parking lot quietly reconsidering next year's schedule. It was the team's second win in two days, following a 283 (-5) performance at the Lake Conference Opener at Braemar on Monday, where they went 1st of 7. Starting a season five-under at your home course with a full lineup intact? Uncomfortable for the Lake Conference. Perfectly normal for Edina.

Torger Ohe led the charge both days, carding a 69 on Monday and backing it up with a 71 on Tuesday. A 69-71 start to the season is the kind of thing that makes opposing coaches take a very long look at their lineup cards.
recaps.jvBody:
The JV squad made the rounds this week, competing at the Lake Conference JV Tournament at Bluff Creek on Monday and the East Ridge JV Event at Clifton Highlands on Tuesday. They came home with a 2nd of 7 and a 2nd of 23 respectively — the kind of early-season results that tend to make other programs check their schedules to see how many times they have to see Edina this year.

Carter Ringle turned in a 76 at East Ridge that would hold up in a lot of varsity lineups. The JV crew is building something and they're doing it fast.
recaps.closingLine: Up next: Varsity heads to Wild Marsh for the Lake Conference Tri. The season is two events old and the Hornets have yet to finish outside the top two in anything. Seems about right.
